SECTION E: Case Study Based (4 Marks)

Q38. Case Study 3: The Brooch
A brooch is made with silver wire in form of a circle diameter 35 mm, and 5 diameters divide it into 10 equal sectors.
(i) Find total length of wire required. (1)
(ii) Find angle of each sector. (1)
(iii) (a) Find area of each sector. (2) OR
(b) If diameter doubled, find area of each sector. (2)

Answer / Solution:
(i) Total wire = circumference + 5 diameters
= π×35 + 5×35
Using π = 22/7: π×35 = 110
So total = 110 + 175 = 285 mm
(ii) Angle each sector = 360°/10 = 36°
(iii)(a) Radius = 17.5 mm
Area of each sector = (1/10)πr^2
= (1/10)×(22/7)×(17.5×17.5) = 96.25 mm^2
(iii)(b) New diameter = 70 mm => r = 35 mm
Area each sector = (1/10)×(22/7)×(35×35) = 385 mm^2
Answers:
(i) 285 mm
(ii) 36°
(iii)(a) 96.25 mm² OR (b) 385 mm²
